description: This file defines the WidgetPluginManager class, which manages plugin types for field widgets in Drupal, including methods for instantiation, configuration, and options retrieval.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\WidgetPluginManager
classes.description: Manages plugin types for field widgets, providing instantiation, configuration, and options management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WidgetPluginManager with necessary dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a widget plugin based on provided options, with fallback to default widget if necessary.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a plugin instance given a plugin ID and configuration, handling container-based instantiation if supported.

methods.name: prepareConfiguration
methods.description: Merges default values into widget configuration, setting defaults for missing properties.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves available widget options for a specific field type or all field types.

methods.name: getDefaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for a specified widget type.
